intended_object: An auxiliary construction. It lists, in increasing order, the physical elapsed times of the strictly positive future coordinates of a finite mixed past/future index set, as an order embedding from `Fin card`. It serves as bookkeeping in the proofs of the restart (Markov property) results.
explanation: The definition composes a cardinality cast (`Fin.castOrderIso`) with the library's `finiteSetTimes`, which sorts a finite set of times. The result is the increasing enumeration of a finite set of positive times built inside the library. It reindexes coordinates so that finite-dimensional kernels can be applied in the restart/mixed past–future argument. The object is specific to the library's encoding (`Set.Iic S ⊕ DenseTime`, `positiveFutureFinset`, the dense-time embedding into physical time) and has no independent standard counterpart in the literature. The closest Mathlib tool is the general sorted enumeration `Finset.orderEmbOfFin`, which this construction effectively uses.
